# Disadvantage

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Disadvantage)*

If you have Disadvantage on a [D20 Test](D20-Test.md), roll two d20s and use the lower roll. A roll can't be affected by more than one Disadvantage, and [Advantage](Advantage.md) and Disadvantage on the same roll cancel each other. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[D20 Tests](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#AdvantageDisadvantage)").
